purpose: Fail-closed persistence bootstrap for all five scheduled ChatGPT automations.

github_primary.prohibition: No research, web search, market scan, code audit, or experimentation before heartbeat readback succeeds.

finalization.pass_10: replace latest.json with exact same verified payload and verify identity

fallback.on_github_failure: Attempt a minimal Library failure receipt containing lane, RUN_ID, timestamp, error, control_plane_id, automation_id; then stop.
fallback.on_library_failure: Emit explicit persistence failure; do not continue substantive work and do not claim RUN_PERSISTED.

watchdog.rule: Each OMEGA run checks sibling isolated latest/heartbeat/history and, when automation-registry access exists, compares last_run_time against durable repo state.
